An '''embassy''' belonging to the [[Kilmaulsi]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kilmaulsias]] was constructed in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Efavan/Legends|Efavan]] on the planet [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]].<ref name="GATORW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The embassy was first mentioned in ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', a supplement released by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2004]] for ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GATORW" />
